decisions.reason: The SK6812 chain remains the charge-status display method; the rail may be enabled whenever those LEDs are needed.
Downstream switching of the 5V boost rail does not change the AXP2101 battery input or its role as the normal upstream system power source.
The 5V_EN rail-control decision does not alter USB data lines, connector sourceability, or the D+/D- interboard route.
The source establishes rail-control behavior but does not change any BOM population, sourcing, or assembly-readiness fact.
The 5V rail and LED shutdown decision does not affect the battery connector family, pin count, functions, part number, or unresolved pin order.
The source does not change I2C speed, pull-ups, cable constraints, or series-resistor conditioning.
Switching the downstream 5V rail does not change battery overcharge, overdischarge, short-circuit, or DW01A protection requirements.
